summary: Today brings a mixed briefing driven by major corporate capital commitments in energy and retail alongside notable judicial decisions in corporate litigation. Key drivers include Reliance's ₹1 lakh crore investment pledge in Andhra Pradesh and High Court rulings regarding corporate executive bail.

bullets.text: Reliance announced plans to invest ₹1 lakh crore in Andhra Pradesh to set up biogas plants, aiming to create 3 lakh job opportunities.
Bodhi Tree Systems is investing $180 million to acquire a majority stake in South Indian restaurant chain Adyar Ananda Bhavan.
The Punjab & Haryana High Court rejected DLF's plea seeking the cancellation of bail granted to its former CFO in an extortion case.
Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care reported a 6.7% YoY drop in Q2 net profit to ₹196 crore due to elevated costs.
SoftBank affiliate SVF II Meerkat offloaded 7.64 crore shares of e-commerce firm Meesho worth ₹1,885 crore via block deals.
